anomaly: Ownly recent-order count contradicts other answers
what_we_found: 1 catchment respondent(s) said they had ordered on Ownly AND that their first order was in the last 4 weeks, while entering 0 orders for that window.
how_it_was_handled: Reported as UNAVAILABLE, not as zero. Excluded from volume-share numerator.

anomaly: thu_lunch audit pass carries no information
what_we_found: All 30 rows record restaurant_listed='y' with no restaurant_open, no timestamp, no prices.
how_it_was_handled: Excluded from coverage (rule R4). Retained and flagged in audit_clean.csv.

what_we_found: 'Zomato'/'zomato', 'Y'/'y', 'Auto offer'/'auto offer' would fork platforms, listing states and price views if left as captured.
'Aanimuthyualu unlimited' vs 'Aanimuthyalu unlimited' — same restaurant, would double-count the coverage denominator.
Every Zomato 'none' capture exists twice — once with delivery fee, once without (Gold). Not duplicates: member and non-member prices of the same basket.
how_it_was_handled: Split into three price views; MAX = non-member, MIN = member.

anomaly: Two audit rows do not reconcile
what_we_found: Line items do not sum to final_payable (>₹1).
how_it_was_handled: Flagged, left as captured, immaterial to matched pairs.

anomaly: Age scope conflict: target says 18–35, instrument collected 20–35
what_we_found: The form routes out 'Under 20', so 18–19-year-olds answered nothing. A later '18–24' band also appears, overlapping two earlier bands.
how_it_was_handled: Reported as '20–35 as collected'. 18–35 is not recoverable.

anomaly: Survey column order changed between exports
what_we_found: The live sheet's column ORDER differs from the earlier CSV export, so positional mapping silently read the wrong questions.
how_it_was_handled: Pipeline now maps by question text + city branch.

anomaly: Brand present but nearest outlet absent
what_we_found: Bawarchi is on Ownly, but not the Gachibowli outlet (first-hand check, 2026-09-19).
how_it_was_handled: Price capture retained. Generated H-OUTLET — see analysis.
